proof_summary: Take \(n=800322180\). Monotonicity of \(\binom{2k+1}{k}\), together with \(\binom{33}{16}=1166803110>n\), reduces both indices to \(0\le c,d\le15\); a finite factorization check then shows that every residual \(n-\binom{2c+1}{c}-\binom{2d+1}{d}\) contains a prime \(p\equiv3\pmod4\) to an odd exponent, so by the sum-of-two-squares obstruction none can equal \(a^2+b^2\).
